SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.product_category_id, p.image_url, pc.name AS category_name, ps.id AS stock_id, ps.product_id AS stock_product_id, ps.quantity AS stock_quantity FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN product_stock ps ON p.id = ps.product_id WHERE p.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
